notes: ACCESS: robots.txt at https://www.sklum.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST via probe.fetch (200, 8902 bytes, PrestaShop-generated). It contains exactly two user-agent groups - 'User-agent: *' (line 9) and 'User-agent: Pinterestbot' (line 157, which carries the Crawl-delay: 0.2 and the blanket 'Disallow: *' at its end). NO group names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai or Claude-Web anywhere in the file, and there is no Content-Signal line, so there is no robots exclusion for us; the blanket Disallow belongs to the Pinterestbot group only. The '*' group disallows query-parameter and controller URLs (?orderby=, ?orderway=, ?order=, ?tag=, ?search_query=, ?back=, ?n=, */search/, */find/, *allattrib=, /api/ecom-bff/*, */product-configurator-3d, */modules/, */classes/ etc.). Every URL recorded here is a bare /es/<id>-comprar-<slug> category path with no query string. The site's own product API (/api/ecom-bff/) is DISALLOWED and was deliberately NOT used; pagination was done with the ?p=N page parameter, which the file does not disallow (only ?n= / &n= are). probe.py's 2s per-host pacing was applied throughout. All pages 200 on rotating curl_cffi fingerprints. TREE: taken from the site's OWN category navigation - Sklum server-renders <nav id="category_list" data-category="NNN" aria-label="Subcategorias de <name>"> on every PLP - cross-checked against each page's ld+json BreadcrumbList, which is what settles the real parent. The Bathroom entry point is the top-nav item 'Baño' = https://www.sklum.com/es/591-comprar-muebles-bano, h1 'Bathroom Furniture and Accessories', breadcrumb HOME > Muebles > Bathroom Furniture and Accessories, 22 entries in its category_list. IMPORTANT: on deep accessory nodes Sklum reuses that same 'Subcategorias de X' block to show SIBLING cross-links (e.g. the block on 'Lavabos' lists Muebles de lavabo / Grifos / Espejos de baño, which are 591 siblings, not children of Lavabos). Those were identified and discarded by comparing each candidate child's own breadcrumb tail; only nodes whose breadcrumb actually ends '...> parent > child' were treated as children. That is how Duchas (24918) was found to be the real parent of Mamparas de ducha, Platos de ducha and Columnas de ducha (their breadcrumbs read ... > Bathroom Furniture and Accessories > Duchas > X), and how Espejos de baño was found to have two real children (con luz, antivaho). The 'Descubre también' block at the foot of 591 (Lavabos redondos 29355, Muebles de resina 28315, Mamparas de ducha negras 29362) is an SEO you-may-like strip, NOT part of the category_list nav, and was excluded. QTY: Sklum's PLP is client-rendered from an inline JSON blob, 'var searchConfiguration = {"total":N,"initialProducts":[...],"categoryId":NNN,"defaultResultsPerPage":50,...}'. That blob is what the grid itself renders from, so its "total" is the page's own figure. The nav's data-nproducts attribute was NOT used - it is stale and demonstrably wrong (nav says 41 for Muebles de baño suspendidos while that page's own total is 75; nav says 38 for Conjuntos while its own total is 83), so every number here comes from the target page itself. VERIFICATION: (a) equivalence proved by enumeration on pages of differing size - Muebles de lavabo total 38 ships 38 initialProducts on a single page; Conjuntos total 83 ships 50 on p1 and exactly 33 on ?p=2; Muebles de baño total 63 ships 50 + 13; Muebles de baño suspendidos total 75 ships 50 + 25. Three paginated categories of different sizes reconcile exactly to 50+remainder, so "total" is the true category total, not a page or facet count. (b) every recorded page's categoryId in the blob equals the id in its URL and its h1 + breadcrumb tail match the node requested. (c) counts discriminate strongly - 265, 101, 88, 69, 45, 44, 39, 38, 35, 28, 26, 18, 17, 15, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 6, 4, 3 - no site-wide constant. DEDUP: already_extracted() run on every candidate leaf. Six hits, all Furniture.xlsx, all moved to review[] and NOT recorded: 22847 Conjuntos de muebles de baño ('Bathroom Furniture Sets'), 30333 Muebles de baño ('Bathroom Vanity Units'), 23263 Muebles de baño suspendidos ('Wall-Hung Bathroom Vanity Units'), 7692 Muebles de lavabo ('Washbasin Units'), 22829 Armarios de baño para colgar ('Wall-Mounted Bathroom Cabinets'), 22858 Estanterías de baño ('Bathroom Shelving Units'). That is the whole bathroom-furniture arm of the tree, exactly as the OPTION 1 policy anticipates. Every URL in rows[] returned None from already_extracted(). EXCLUDED / JUDGEMENT CALLS: 591 itself (265), Duchas (101), Mamparas de ducha (45), Platos de ducha (38), Espejos de baño (26) and Accesorios y complementos para el Baño (131) all have valid child listings, so they are grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rule 24); their totals are never reused for a child and siblings are never summed (note e.g. Espejos de baño 26 vs children 12+12, and Mamparas 45 vs children 28+17+8 - the children overlap and under-cover respectively, which is exactly why no arithmetic was done). Two nodes whose canonical breadcrumb is Muebles de almacenaje were nonetheless KEPT in Bathroom because their primary product type is bathroom-specific and the site also files them under Accesorios y complementos para el Baño: 'Organizadores de baño' (69) and 'Papeleras de baño' (9) - rules 2, 12, 13. The parallel nodes that are NOT bathroom-specific by product type ('Cestos para la ropa', 'Organizadores de maquillaje') were left for Storage and put in review[]. Route-outs (Iluminación para el baño and its two children -> Lighting; Textil de baño, Toallas de baño, Alfombras de baño, Juegos de toallas -> Textile; Velas -> Decor), the sale branch 'Rebajas Muebles de Baño' and the general Decoración > Espejos node are all in review[] so nothing is silently skipped.
